extracted.intended_audience: Users of the PARI/GP modular forms library — computational number theorists and developers working with modular forms in PARI/GP
extracted.subtask_description: Reference documentation for PARI/GP functions handling modular forms: descriptions of functions, input/output conventions, special cases, warnings, and usage examples. Intended to guide correct use and understanding of each mf* routine.

rubrics_metrics.name: mffields
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the polynomials defining each Galois orbit of newforms over Q(χ) for a given modular form space (mf).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shows examples where characters change Q(χ) (trivial, primitive, order 4), and indicates library syntax: GEN mffields(GEN mf). Examples illustrate number of newforms and fields of definition.

rubrics_metrics.name: mffromell
rubrics_metrics.description: Given an elliptic curve E over Q (ellinit integral model), computes [mf, F, v] where F is the newform corresponding to E by modularity, mf is the newspace, and v gives coefficients of F on mfbasis(mf).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: ellinit("26a1") then mffromell returns coefficients matching ellan(E,n). Library syntax: GEN mffromell(GEN E).

rubrics_metrics.name: mffrometaquo
rubrics_metrics.description: Computes the modular form corresponding to an eta quotient matrix eta. If valuation at infinity is fractional, return 0. If the eta quotient is meromorphic, return 0 when flag=0, or return the eta quotient divided by q^{-v} when flag is set (so valuation 0).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Accepts t_VEC as single-row factorization. Examples show returns 0 for nonholomorphic or fractional valuation, and how to obtain q-normalized series with flag=1. Library syntax: GEN mffrometaquo(GEN eta, long flag).

rubrics_metrics.name: mffromlfun
rubrics_metrics.description: Given an L-function (lfun format) representing a self-dual modular form, returns [NK, space, v] such that mf = mfinit(NK,space) contains the form and mftobasis(mf,v) represents it on the basis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If L has rational coefficients, recognition is straightforward. For inexact complex coefficients, compute eigenbasis for mf and compare attached L-functions numerically. Library syntax: GEN mffromlfun(GEN L, long prec).

rubrics_metrics.name: mffromqf
rubrics_metrics.description: Given an even integral positive definite quadratic form Q and optional homogeneous spherical polynomial P, computes [mf, F, v] where F is the theta function for (Q,P), mf the modular form space, and v coefficients of F on mfbasis(mf).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supports very large coefficient queries (mfcoef) and half-integral weights (odd dimensions). Examples show timing and large-coefficient results. Library syntax: GEN mffromqf(GEN Q, GEN P = NULL).

rubrics_metrics.name: mfgaloistype
rubrics_metrics.description: For NK = [N,1,CHI] or an mf in weight 1, returns vector of types of Galois representations attached to each cuspidal eigenform (or for a specified F). Types A4,S4,A5 coded as negatives of their cardinality; Dn represented by 2n.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Does not verify that F belongs to the correct space nor that it is cuspidal eigenform when F given. Library syntax: GEN mfgaloistype(GEN NK, GEN F = NULL). Examples include outputs like [-12] for A4, [-24] for S4, or mixtures like [10,-60].

rubrics_metrics.name: mfhecke
rubrics_metrics.description: Given modular form space mf and form F, returns T(n)F, the image of F under the n-th Hecke operator.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Warning: if F has level M < N, T(n)F at level M is in general not same as at level N; this function uses the same level as mf. Supports half-integral weight but then n must be a perfect square (otherwise operator acts as 0). For large composite n, using mfheckemat on mftobasis coefficients is more efficient. Library syntax: GEN mfhecke(GEN mf, GEN F, long n).

rubrics_metrics.name: mfheckemat
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the matrix of the Hecke operator T(n) on mfbasis(mf) when vecn is integer, or a vector of such matrices when vecn is a vector (usually faster than individual calls).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples show returned matrices and use with vectors [5,7]. Library syntax: GEN mfheckemat(GEN mf, GEN vecn).

rubrics_metrics.name: mfinit
rubrics_metrics.description: Create the modular forms space corresponding to NK and space code (default 4). NK may be [N,k], [N,k,CHI], or a modular form or space, in which case mfparams defines the parameters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Space codes: 0 newspace Snew, 1 ? (note text had broken line) 3 Eisenstein Ek, 4 cuspidal Sk, 2 oldspace Sold, full space Mk. Supports wildcards: CHI may be 0 (wildcard) to return vector of mfinit(s) for each Galois orbit; CHI may be vector of characters. In weight 1 only Snew, S1 and E1 support wildcards. Output is technical structure S; use mfparams(S), mfdim(S), mfbasis(S). Library syntax: GEN mfinit(GEN NK, long space). Examples show wildcard returns list of spaces and mfdim values.

rubrics_metrics.name: mfisCM
rubrics_metrics.description: Tests whether an eigenform F is a CM form. Returns 0 if not; if yes returns the unique negative discriminant of the CM field, or pair of discriminants in weight 1 when projective image is D2 (coded 4 by mfgaloistype).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples show outputs like -3 or Vecsmall([-3,-39]). Library syntax: GEN mfisCM(GEN F).

rubrics_metrics.name: mfisequal
rubrics_metrics.description: Checks equality of modular forms F and G. If lim is nonzero, only check equality of first lim+1 Fourier coefficients (useful for generalized modular forms).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: comparing derivative vs product; library syntax long mfisequal(GEN F, GEN G, long lim). Returns 1 if equal.

rubrics_metrics.name: mfkohnenbasis
rubrics_metrics.description: For a cuspidal space mf of half-integral weight k≥3/2 with level N and character χ (conductor of χ or χ·(-4/.) must divide N/4), returns matrix B whose columns are coefficients of a basis of Kohnen + -space.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives examples and error when conductor condition fails. Library syntax: GEN mfkohnenbasis(GEN mf).

rubrics_metrics.name: mfkohnenbijection
rubrics_metrics.description: For cuspidal half-integral weight mf, returns [mf2, M, K, shi] where M gives Hecke-module isomorphism from S_{2k-1}(Γ0(N),χ^2) to Kohnen + -space S^+_k(Γ0(4N),χ); K represents basis of Kohnen + -space, shi gives linear combination of Shimura lifts giving M^{-1}.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Since bijection is of Hecke modules it lets one transport Hecke operators, newspace, eigenspaces, eigenforms between levels. Examples show using K, M to transfer T_11^2 quickly. Library syntax: GEN mfkohnenbijection(GEN mf).

rubrics_metrics.name: mfkohneneigenbasis
rubrics_metrics.description: Given cuspidal half-integral weight mf and bij (output of mfkohnenbijection), outputs [mf0, BNEW, BEIGEN] where BNEW columns are Kohnen new space basis, BEIGEN columns are eigenforms on basis of mf, and mf0 is corresponding new space of integral weight 2k-1.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples show matrices and lifting of coefficients. Library syntax: GEN mfkohneneigenbasis(GEN mf, GEN bij).

rubrics_metrics.name: mflinear
rubrics_metrics.description: Given vF (vector of generalized modular forms) and v (vector of same length), compute linear combination of vF entries with coefficients v. Allows use to subtract forms or multiply by scalar.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Convenience: accept modular form space mf as vF argument (interpreted as mfbasis(mf)), and allow modular form f as v (interpreted as mftobasis). Examples show replacing complex form by linear combination of basis functions for efficiency. Library syntax: GEN mflinear(GEN vF, GEN v).

rubrics_metrics.name: mfmanin
rubrics_metrics.description: Given modular symbol FS associated to an eigenform F (mfsymbol(mf,F)), compute even and odd special polynomials and even/odd periods ω+, ω− as [[P+,P-],[ω+,ω-,r]] where r=(ω+ω-)/<F,F>. If multiple embeddings into C exist, returns vector for each embedding.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples for mfDelta and weight 2 forms. Library syntax: GEN mfmanin(GEN FS, long bitprec).

rubrics_metrics.name: mfmul
rubrics_metrics.description: Multiply two generalized modular forms F and G.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples show E4^3 computed. Library syntax: GEN mfmul(GEN F, GEN G).

rubrics_metrics.name: mfnumcusps
rubrics_metrics.description: mfnumcusps(N) returns number of cusps of Γ0(N).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: mfnumcusps(24) = 8; mfcusps(24) lists cusp representatives. Library syntax: GEN mfnumcusps(GEN N).

rubrics_metrics.name: mfparams
rubrics_metrics.description: If argument is a modular form space, returns [N,k,CHI,space]; if a generalized modular form returns [N,k,CHI,P] where P is polynomial giving field of definition of f (note: level N may be multiple of true level and P may define larger field than Q(f)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To get true level use mfconductor(mfinit(F),F). f.mod returns polynomial used to define Q(f) over Q. Examples show mfparams for Eisenstein products, eigenforms, and that mfparams(f)[4] is polynomial P. Library syntax: GEN mfparams(GEN F).

rubrics_metrics.name: mfperiodpol
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns period polynomial of the cuspidal part of form f (integral (X-τ)^{k-2} f(τ) dτ). flag=0 ordinary, 1 or -1 for even/odd parts. f may be modular symbol from mfsymbol.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples with mfDelta show normalization and bestappr usage. Library syntax: GEN mfperiodpol(GEN mf, GEN f, long flag, long bitprec).

rubrics_metrics.name: mfperiodpolbasis
rubrics_metrics.description: Gives basis of period polynomials for weight k; flag=1 or -1 returns basis of odd or even period polynomials respectively.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: mfperiodpolbasis(12,1) and (12,-1). Library syntax: GEN mfperiodpolbasis(long k, long flag).

rubrics_metrics.name: mfpetersson
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute Petersson scalar product of modular forms f and g belonging to same space mf, given by modular symbols fs and gs (output of mfsymbol). If gs omitted, uses fs. Normalized by factor 1/[Γ:Γ0(N)].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If forms noncuspidal and product divergent, returns error. Output type depends on fields of definition Q(f), Q(g): scalar if equal to Q(χ), otherwise matrices/vectors per embeddings. Works in weight 1 and half-integral weight where symbols do not exist. Examples include numerical outputs and noncuspidal examples. Library syntax: GEN mfpetersson(GEN fs, GEN gs = NULL).

rubrics_metrics.name: mfpow
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute integer power F^n where F is generalized modular form and n integer.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: mfpow(mfEk(4),3). Library syntax: GEN mfpow(GEN F, long n).

rubrics_metrics.name: mfsearch
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for modular forms with rational coefficients of given weight k and level N whose initial coefficients a(0),... match vector V. space specifies spaces to search (mfinit or mfdim notation).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Character must be of form (D/.) with fundamental discriminant D dividing N. Results sorted by increasing |D| and optionally by level if NK is vector/list of levels. Useful NK forms: [N1..N2], F*[N1..N2], divisors(N0). Note difference vs mfeigensearch which searches rational eigenforms only. Library syntax: GEN mfsearch(GEN NK, GEN V, long space).

rubrics_metrics.name: mfshift
rubrics_metrics.description: Divide generalized modular form F by q^s, omitting remainder if present. s may be negative.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: shifting mfDelta by +1,+2,-1 to show truncated/padded coefficient vectors. Library syntax: GEN mfshift(GEN F, long s).

rubrics_metrics.name: mfshimura
rubrics_metrics.description: For F a half-integral weight k≥3/2 form and D a discriminant of suitable sign, returns Shimura lift [mf2, G, v] where G is weight 2k−1 form corresponding to D, mf2 a space containing G and v gives coefficients on mfbasis(mf2).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sign of D must equal (−1)^{k−1/2}·(±1) depending on whether χ or (−4/.)χ is defined modulo N/4; error otherwise. D may be positive squarefree integer with caveat that Kohnen + -space image level may be N/2 instead of N/4. Examples show mfparams of outputs and that G may have lower level than expected. Library syntax: GEN mfshimura(GEN mf, GEN F, long D).

rubrics_metrics.name: mfslashexpansion
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute Fourier expansion of f|_k g to n terms where mf is modular form space, f∈mf, g∈M^+_2(Q). Behavior depends on flrat: if flrat=0 returns floating complex vector v of expansion of f|_k g with parameters α (rational), width w; if flrat=1 tries to rationalize coefficients (express as rationals or polmods) and returns expansion of F = f|_k M with params [α,w,A] where g=λ·M·A decomposition is used.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains decomposition g = λ·M·A with λ∈Q*, M∈SL2(Z), A upper triangular primitive [a,b;0,d]. Returned expansion must be adjusted by (a/d)^{k/2} and twist e(αb/(dw)). Rationalization can fail and produce error. If [Q(f):Q(χ)]>1 coefficients may be polynomials in y (root of field polynomial). Examples show computing Atkin-Lehner images and rationalized expansions with params output. Library syntax: GEN mfslashexpansion(GEN mf, GEN f, GEN g, long n, long flrat, GEN *params = NULL, long prec).

rubrics_metrics.name: mfspace
rubrics_metrics.description: Identify modular space mf (or form f in mf) as the flag used to mfinit: returns 0 (newspace), 1 (cuspidal space), 2 (old space), 3 (Eisenstein space) or 4 (full space).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Returns −1 when form f is modular but does not belong to the space. When f not modular (quasi-modular) may return nonsense. Examples show typical returns and pitfalls. Library syntax: long mfspace(GEN mf, GEN f = NULL).

rubrics_metrics.name: mfsplit
rubrics_metrics.description: Given mf containing the new space (integral weight), split space into Galois orbits of eigenforms of the newspace, possibly restricted by dimlim (only compute orbits of dimension ≤ dimlim) and flag (speeds up for large dimension: if flag=d>0 and eigenspace dimension>d only compute Galois polynomial). Returns [vF, vK] where vF gives eigenforms and vK polynomials defining each Galois orbit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note mfeigenbasis returns all eigenforms in easier format; mfsplit useful when restricting to small orbits e.g. rational eigenforms. Examples show timings and use of dimlim to speed up. Library syntax: GEN mfsplit(GEN mf, long dimlim, long flag).

rubrics_metrics.name: mfsturm
rubrics_metrics.description: Gives Sturm bound for modular forms on Γ0(N) and weight k: upper bound for order of zero at infinity of a nonzero form. NK may be [N,k] or mfinit output in which case exact bound returned.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: mfsturm([96,6])=97; mfsturm(mfinit(...)) may return smaller exact bound. Library syntax: long mfsturm(GEN NK).

rubrics_metrics.name: mfsymbol
rubrics_metrics.description: Initialize data for working with period polynomials of modular form f: returns an mfsymbol, essential for efficiency in mfsymboleval, mfmanin, mfpetersson. mfsymbol contains mf structure and can be used where mf would be needed. For weight 1 and half-integral weight (where no symbols exist), used by abuse of language to initialize data for mfpetersson.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Accepts mfsymbol(f) shorthand for mfsymbol(mfinit(f), f). Examples show timings and reuse of existing symbol to speed repeated Petersson computations. Library syntax: GEN mfsymbol(GEN mf, GEN f = NULL, long bitprec).

rubrics_metrics.name: mfsymboleval
rubrics_metrics.description: Evaluate modular symbol fs (from mfsymbol) on path (vector [s1,s2] or integral matrix [a,b;c,d] representing [a/c,b/d]). s1,s2 (or a/c,b/d) can be upper half-plane elements. Optional ga∈GL_2^+(Q) replaces F by F|_k γ. If integral diverges result is rational function. If Q(f) larger than Q(χ) returns vector for all embeddings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Returns polynomial equal to ∫_{s1}^{s2} (X-τ)^{k-2} F(τ) dτ. Describes limits used when s2=∞ and divergence handling including adding appropriate polynomial terms involving a(0) or b(0). Examples include evaluations for cuspidal and noncuspidal cases. Library syntax: GEN mfsymboleval(GEN fs, GEN path, GEN ga = NULL, long bitprec).

rubrics_metrics.name: mftaylor
rubrics_metrics.description: For F in Mk(SL2(Z)), compute first n+1 canonical Taylor expansion coefficients of F around τ=I. If flreal=0 computes only algebraic equivalence class; if flreal set compute pn such that near I f(τ) = (2i/(τ+I))^k ∑_{n≥0} p_n((τ−I)/(τ+I))^n.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: mftaylor(mfDelta,8) returns rational coefficients. Library syntax: GEN mftaylor(GEN F, long n, long flreal, long prec).

rubrics_metrics.name: mftobasis
rubrics_metrics.description: Return coefficients of form F on basis mfbasis(mf). F may be a q-expansion or vector of coefficients instead of a modular form, but short expansions may cause errors. If flag set then instead of errors output is affine space of solutions [v,K] when expansion insufficient; empty column if no solutions or form not in space.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples show using symbolic coefficients [a,b] or series truncated, and how mftobasis with flag=1 returns candidate solution and matrix K describing affine family. If input doesn't belong to space result may match up to bound and then error; with flag=1 avoids error messages. Library syntax: GEN mftobasis(GEN mf, GEN F, long flag).

rubrics_metrics.name: mftocoset
rubrics_metrics.description: Given N, matrix M∈SL2(Z) and Lcosets = mfcosets(N) (list of right cosets of Γ0(N)), find coset to which M belongs. Output [γ,i] such that M = γ Lcosets[i], γ∈Γ0(N).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example shows mftocoset(4,[1,1;2,3],L). Library syntax: GEN mftocoset(long N, GEN M, GEN Lcosets).

rubrics_metrics.name: mftonew
rubrics_metrics.description: Given mf (full or cuspidal space) and cusp form F in that space, return vector of 3-component vectors [M,d,G] with f having decomposition via B(d)(G) where G∈Snew(Γ0(M),χ) and f = sum B(d)(G) over these vectors with M|N and d|N/M.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example shows decomposition of a basis element and matching coefficients. Library syntax: GEN mftonew(GEN mf, GEN F).

rubrics_metrics.name: mftraceform
rubrics_metrics.description: For NK=[N,k,CHI,...] (integral k), returns the trace form in corresponding subspace of Sk(Γ0(N),χ). space argument: 0 newspace (default), 1 full cuspidal space.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples show mftraceform([23,2]) and mftraceform([23,1,-23]). Library syntax: GEN mftraceform(GEN NK, long space).
